en: I'll lie low in this disused dock
for a while.
Most likely
note: Followed by the partner-name opcode and @4A8 on the same line: 'Most likely {PARTNER_NAME}, too,'.

en: , too,
is waiting for his chance to set sail.
Compared with Medoekia, this is quite
a large town.
First, let me see what the town is like.
Orgo, arrange for the coffin to be
note: Duran to Orgo. Rows regrouped: 'London estate' moved to @3F8.

en: delivered to the London estate.
Understood, Master.
It will be some time before the ship sails.
I shall be staying in this town a while, then.
So at last we are to be wed.
It all seems like a dream.
Rowena, after the wedding, I had meant
to hold the rite to formally welcome you
into our clan.
But...
If you join our clan and gain eternal life,
you must lose something in exchange.
With your power, basking in the sun by day
would no longer be possible.
And the rose you now hold in your hand...
Roses never let monsters draw near.
However beautiful we may find them,
we can never touch them...
If we force ourselves to touch one
note: Followed on the same line by @190 printed six times with pauses: '......'.
Shared: printed six times after @194 and six times after @180, each with a pause, giving '......' (same approach as EP0@8FC / EP1@FC).

en: this is what happens.
Ah!
note: Rowena's startled cry (lone ！), followed by @190 x6: 'Ah!......'. Same rendering as EP1@5C.

en: You, who love roses so dearly,
might be happier if you could remain
human, just as you are...
Pardon me,
note: Messenger (soldier); followed by the player-name opcode and @100: 'Pardon me, {PLAYER_NAME}, my lord.' Trailing space.

en: , my lord.
What is it?!
The army of Rakova, which borders our Medoekia,
has invaded our lands. Word has just come.
Very well. I shall go at once.
note: Duran; same opening as EP0@364/EP1@898 ('Very well. I shall come at once'), 'go' here since he leaves for the front.

en: You, go and gather the troops.
Yes, my lord!
Rowena, I shall return in ten days or so...
Wait for me.
To battle!
I shall spare no one!
